body:
B5-19b is ready for review: origin/wp/B5-19b at 1051580f, based on dd2cf300. Commits: 3dc50dee (RED), ccf91fc0 (fix), 1051580f (HANDOFF).

1. Budget: half of physical RAM at about 50 B per pixel, capped at 200 MP. That's 85 MP at 8 GiB and 171 MP at 16 GiB; if RAM can't be read, it stays at 200 MP. It reads hw.memsize via a local sysctlbyname declaration, using the same unsafe extern pattern as surface.rs, with /proc/meminfo elsewhere. No new crate. Errors name the actual limit. Tests inject the memory value.
2. Late cancel follows the DocumentRetouch pattern: a committed step into a document is undone; a finished new Photomerge document is closed without being installed; a cancel before the edit reports "nothing changed". Align and Blend busy sheets now have Cancel too. It acts when the engine returns, and the notes say so. ACCEPTANCE-STEPS 442–443 are updated.
3. Colour: Photomerge only converts when the profiles differ, and there's a regression test. Engine ask: color-mgmt built-in profiles embed their creation second in ICC header byte 35 and the profile ID, so two sRGB handles made a second apart compare unequal. B works around it by ignoring the date and ID bytes. Please make built-in profile output deterministic.
4. HANDOFF documents why HEIC, PSD and native files are refused as file sources, and the workarounds.

Gates: full tessera-ffi passes. A smart_preview_thumbnail parallel-state flake passed alone and on the full rerun; it looks like those tests share state. Clippy and fmt are clean, SWIFT GATE OK with 777 tests.

Also ready, from the previous message: B5-17d at 61b6bdb4. B5-18b (Camera Raw viewport preview) is still in progress.
